title: Riffle mined history manifest
description: Manifest written by the Go history miner (services/miner) for one repository and one run, next to the Parquet tables it lists. pipelines/ and scorer read the tables only through this manifest. Tables are raw history, not model features: every feature is computed in Python from these tables, in training and serving alike. Data stays inside the installation; author emails are stored only as salted hashes. A run is usable only when status is complete; partial runs carry a checkpoint and are resumed, never read.

run_id.description: Unique per run; reruns with the same run_id overwrite the same files (idempotent)

miner_version.description: Pinned into model_version via the feature extractor version

window.description: History covered. Backfill runs recent-first (rules model.backfill), so a partial run always covers the newest data.

head_sha.description: Default branch head the run mined up to

checkpoint.description: Where a partial or failed run resumes. Opaque to readers.

rate_limit.description: GitHub API budget used, for capacity planning.

conditional_hits.description: 304 responses, which do not count against the limit

coverage.description: What history was actually available. Feeds labels.unobserved in the label builder.

check_runs_from.description: Earliest check result still retrievable; ci_fail is unobserved before this

uri.description: gs:// or file:// path to the Parquet file

commits.author_login: string or null, resolved through identity rules
commits.message: string, used by pattern and link rules

file_changes.old_path: string or null, set on rename

check_runs.name: string
check_runs.conclusion: success | failure | neutral | cancelled | skipped | timed_out | action_required | null
